title: Implement controller-only preview modal
description: Implement the Filter Controller preview modal as a contextual contract preview, not a frontend listing preview.
objective: Close frame 16 and modal behavior without adding runtime filtering.
acceptance_criteria: The modal opens from current in-memory form state without saving.
The modal remains contextual to the selected preset/state.
Keyboard close and escape behavior are safe enough for WP admin.
verification: Confirm preview does not save data.
risks: Preview may accidentally imply runtime filtering exists.
Modal focus behavior may conflict with WordPress admin chrome.
